name: H5N1 bird flu
value: US H5N1 death (1 Nov); no human spread
summary: Cambodia and Washington State report new H5N1 cases; no human-to-human spread
state: A Yakima County, Washington resident exposed to infected dairy cattle died of H5N1 on 1 Nov, the first US bird flu death of 2026 (CNN). Cambodia confirmed its first human H5N1 case of the year (CIDRAP). Cases remain animal-linked, the CDC rates the public risk as low, and no person-to-person spread has been found as of 5 Nov.
for_you: The public risk is low; people working with poultry or dairy cattle should follow CDC or UKHSA guidance.

sources.title: CNN — Washington reports first US bird flu death of 2026
CIDRAP — Cambodia confirms its first human H5N1 case this year

why: H5N1 is the flu strain scientists most fear could become a pandemic; it has spread to mammals and dairy cattle.
drivers: Human cases, mammal-to-mammal spread, mutations, surveillance.

rubric.watch: Human clusters under investigation, rising human cases, or new mammalian species spread.
